visual_style: antique parchment background with subtle grain
clean TCG UI language with a large art window

rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: The realm and reign under one perfect rule, gathering every redeemed one
content.ART_PROMPT: A radiant throne on a high hill crowned with golden light, rivers of small robed figures streaming toward it from every horizon across a wide plain, city walls shining at dawn, all figures distant and seen from behind, engraved devotional style on warm parchment tones
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Each player adds one card from Sheol to their hand. Then add up to three cards from Sheol to your hand.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: the kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Daniel 2:44 — “a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Revelation 11:15 — “the kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: Hebrew malkut and Greek basileia name both the realm and the active reign of the king.
Daniel told Babylon's own king of a kingdom that would break every empire and stand forever.
Revelation 11:15 crowns the story: the kingdoms of this world become the kingdom of our Lord.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card with collector number #039. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Every filled pip is one flat, solid, uniformly dark navy disc with no highlight, gloss, gradient, inner ring, or concentric texture; every empty pip is a thin navy outline with plain parchment interior. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
